Pumps notification requests without waiting for service replies; dispatches callbacks. Source   Edit   
proc sendNotification(title, body: string; icon: Image = nil;
                      onClick: Callback = nil;
                      onError: NotificationErrorCallback = nil): Notification {.
    ...raises: [WindyError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Queues a notification without waiting for the desktop service. Plain text is used; the optional image is supplied through the standard image-data hint. Use the thread that calls pollEvents. Invalid input raises immediately. Click callbacks require desktop action support. Delivery errors call onError, or raise WindyError from pollEvents when onError is absent. The desktop controls presentation; acceptance does not guarantee a visible popup. The application name defaults to the executable name. No tray icon is needed. Source   Edit   
proc update(notification: Notification; title, body: string; icon: Image = nil) {.
    ...raises: [WindyError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Replaces the content and image while retaining callbacks. Nil clears the image. Updates before a reply are coalesced. A closed handle cannot be reused. Source   Edit
